proposal.hypothesis: Requiring the agent to run and observe the task's own verifier before submission addresses reward-zero trials returning a wrong artifact.
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Solve-mode prompt now requires running and observing the task's verifier or test entrypoint before any final reply, addressing wrong-artifact failures.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy.
In solve mode the candidate:identity text forbids a final reply while the task verifier reports failure.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
